description:
Jimson Weed (Datura stramonium), also called thorn apple or devil’s trumpet, is extremely toxic to cats. Every part of the plant can be dangerous, including the leaves, seeds, flowers, and stems.

The plant contains tropane alkaloids such as atropine, scopolamine, and hyoscyamine. These chemicals block normal nerve signals in the body. Even a small exposure can affect the heart, brain, eyes, gut, and body temperature.

Signs can include wide pupils, drooling or dry mouth, vomiting, fast heartbeat, agitation, weakness, tremors, seizures, or collapse. This is an emergency. If your cat chews or eats any part of Jimson weed, contact a veterinarian or emergency clinic immediately.
